summary: Iteration 3 (v1.2 RFP/RFQ module) — Backend pytest 54/54 PASSED (44 baseline + 10 new). Frontend Playwright verified: admin nav-admin-rfp-rfq, RFP/RFQ board with tabs & filter API calls, RFP/RFQ create forms (rfp-block, rfq-block, criterion+committee builders, total-weight indicator), buyer nav-buyer-new-rfp/rfq, TenderList Type column with badges, RFQ publish end-to-end -> detail with tender-doctype='RFQ' + line-items table, RFP publish -> detail with tender-rfp-block + criteria + committee, vendor RFQ bid with line-item price grid + auto-computed bid-total + readOnly bid-amount, vendor RFP bid with technical/commercial/team textareas, plain TENDER bid with only bid-proposal. Backward compatibility with legacy tenders confirmed.

minor.issue: TenderIn.document_type default is 'tender' but existing tender docs in DB do not have this field. GET returns them without the field (frontend gracefully falls back to 'tender'). Consider a one-off migration to backfill document_type='tender' on legacy docs for consistency.

BidIn.proposal is a required str, but the RFP UI does not render bid-proposal textarea (only tech/commercial/team). Empty string default works today, but semantically the field should either be Optional[str] on BidIn or always rendered somewhere. Currently it silently posts proposal=''.

Server does not validate evaluation_criteria weight sum == 100 — this is only enforced client-side. A malicious/API-direct client can persist an RFP with weights summing to 73 or 200. Add server-side validation.

issues: Category dropdown still uses only the KZ industry category list — for generic RFP consulting there is no 'Consulting' or generic 'Services' option; users must pick 'Land survey & demarcation' or similar. Consider a category-mode toggle or 'General/Other' option for RFPs.
Still uses native browser datetime-local picker (carry-over from iter 1&2 — inconsistent with shadcn design system).
Badges use pmc-label text-transform:uppercase CSS — visually correct (TENDER/RFP/RFQ) but DOM text is lowercase. Not a bug, just a testing note for future agents to use case-insensitive matching.

action_items: (Optional) Backfill document_type='tender' on legacy tender docs in Mongo.
(Optional / hardening) Server-side validation that evaluation_criteria weights sum to 100 on RFP create.
(Optional / clarity) Make BidIn.proposal Optional or always render bid-proposal on RFP form.
(Optional / UX) Provide a generic/global category list for RFP/RFQ that isn't limited to KZ industry categories.
(Carry-over) Replace native datetime-local input with shadcn DatePicker on CreateTender.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py now 929 lines — v1.2 added ~40 more lines. Split into routers (payments/, auth/, tenders/, bids/, reference/) is overdue.
TenderIn uses model_config extra='allow' — flexible but means clients can pollute Mongo docs with arbitrary keys. Consider explicit fields only or a validated extra whitelist.
AdminRfpRfq tab switch fetches with document_type param on tab click — good. But initial mount depends on state default 'rfp' — works because default tab triggers first fetch.
CreateTender.jsx: weight validation happens client-side only (line 275 total-weight indicator). Move critical business rules server-side.

TenderDetail.jsx renders bid-proposal only when !isRFP (line 389). But BidIn requires proposal. If backend adds pydantic validation upgrade later, RFP submissions with empty proposal may fail — hidden coupling.
list_bids buyer branch when mine=false still computes my_tender_ids list even when tender_id is given (dead branch preserved from iter1 & iter2 — still not cleaned up).
